name: We Were Just Kids
source:
"[i]Too much, too soon, or was that simply my excuse?[/i]"

Our Protagonist ([b]Rainn Nichols[/b]) has just moved to New York with her mother after her father vanished into thin air. Left with little more than a paycheck to live on and a broken down truck to move them around, our protagonist is uprooted from her home and now ex-boyfriend, forced to live in a motel on the wrong side of the Big Apple. This is where she meets our other protagonist ([b]Logan Knox[/b]), the red-haired guitarist and founding member of the virtually unknown instrumental metalcore band, We Were Just Kids. Made up of himself, bassist Jason Butler, and drummer Reagan Lee. What begins as our protagonist joining the band on the fly for a school talent show swiftly evolves into the quartet being thrusted into a spotlight of sex, drugs, music, fame, love, and perhaps death.

Not everything is as it seems on the surface. The corruption of music, the lack of balance in the industry's power dynamic, and the temptations of stardom all test the unity of the band as past relationships come back to haunt our protagonists. Can they handle the heat of the spotlight, or the pressure of sudden fame? Can our protagonists operate through the weeds? Or will they crumble like the many before them?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/MissFortuneGames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
「[i]是太多、太快了嗎？還是這不過是我的藉口？[/i]」

主角（[b]Rainn Nichols[/b]）剛和母親搬到紐約，在這之前，父親突然人間蒸發。母女倆只剩一份薪水度日，還有一輛破舊卡車代步。主角被迫離開家鄉和前男友，住進紐約「大蘋果城」治安欠佳地帶的一家汽車旅館。她在那裡遇見另一位主角（[b]Logan Knox[/b]）：他是紅髮吉他手，也是幾乎無人知曉的器樂金屬核樂團《We Were Just Kids》的創團成員。樂團由他、貝斯手Jason Butler和鼓手Reagan Lee組成。主角臨時加入樂團，準備參加學校的才藝表演；沒想到，這件事很快讓四人被推上聚光燈下，捲入性、毒品、音樂、名望、愛情，甚至死亡。

表象之下並非一切如常。音樂產業的腐化、行業權力關係的失衡，以及成名的誘惑，都在考驗樂團的團結；過往的情感糾葛也再度糾纏著主角們。他們能承受聚光燈的灼熱和一夜成名的壓力嗎？主角們能否在重重險阻中繼續前行？還是會像許多人一樣就此崩潰？
